manifest.description: Plan comparison with the signed-in organization's current plan highlighted.

manifest.title: Privacy policy
manifest.description: The privacy policy document.

manifest.name: terms
manifest.title: Terms of service
manifest.description: The terms of service document.

manifest.name: analytics
manifest.title: Product analytics
manifest.description: Capturer port with a PostHog adapter and a no-op default so every call site can fire and forget.

manifest.name: announcements
manifest.title: Product announcements
manifest.description: Administrator-authored banners shown to signed-in users, cached one at a time and invalidated on every admin mutation.

manifest.name: api
manifest.title: JSON API
manifest.description: The second transport: bearer-token authentication, per-token rate limiting, idempotency keys, cursor pagination, and the OpenAPI description.

environment.description: Per-API-token request budget per minute; bursts to twice this

manifest.name: apphost
manifest.title: Application host seam
manifest.description: Leaf ambient-environment seam (configuration lookup, logging, clock, version) that every runtime module is constructed against.

manifest.name: audit
manifest.title: Audit log
manifest.description: Fire-and-forget audit trail. Errors are logged, never returned: an audit hiccup must not fail the caller.

environment.description: Audit janitor retention in days; 0 retains forever

manifest.name: billing
manifest.title: Billing
manifest.description: Plan truth, entitlement checks, the provider client port, and subscription webhook state machine.

environment.description: Polar product id for the pro plan
Polar product id for the team plan

manifest.name: config
manifest.title: Configuration
manifest.description: Environment parsing and validation. Reads through the host seam so a runtime can boot against a fixed environment.

environment.description: Freezes the render clock under APP_ENV=test

manifest.name: content
manifest.title: Content and CMS
manifest.description: Embedded markdown corpus, goldmark rendering, RSS, search, and the database-backed CMS for administrator-authored entries, revisions, and media.

manifest.name: content-assets
manifest.title: Embedded content corpus
manifest.description: The markdown corpus shipped inside the binary: documentation, blog posts, and the changelog, so a fresh clone has real content with no database.

manifest.name: database
manifest.title: Database
manifest.description: The Postgres connection pool, the embedded migration runner, and the generated query layer's configuration. Owns the pool lifecycle: opening, migrating, and closing.

manifest.name: feature-flags
manifest.title: Feature flags
manifest.description: Database-backed flags with a short in-process cache, deterministic percentage bucketing, and per-organization overrides.

manifest.name: i18n
manifest.title: Localization
manifest.description: Locale detection middleware, catalog lookup, and the English and Spanish catalogs. UI strings resolve through T(ctx, key).

manifest.name: identity
manifest.title: Identity
manifest.description: Authentication ports (verifier, user fetcher, deleter), request context keys, and provider account sync.

environment.description: Clerk Frontend API origin; feeds CSP connect-src
Synthetic e2e sessions; refused in production

manifest.name: impersonation
manifest.title: Support impersonation
manifest.description: Audited, time-boxed administrator impersonation of a user, including the recorded reason.

manifest.name: jobs
manifest.title: Background job queue
manifest.description: The Postgres-backed worker: SKIP LOCKED claiming, a visibility timeout, exponential backoff, dead-lettering, the scheduler pass, and the janitors.

manifest.name: llm
manifest.title: Language model
manifest.description: Completer port backed by any OpenAI-compatible API. Unconfigured leaves the port nil so AI routes answer 503.

manifest.name: mail
manifest.title: Transactional mail
manifest.description: Sender port with a Resend adapter and a development sender that writes to disk.

environment.description: Resend API key; unset uses the dev sender

manifest.name: metrics
manifest.title: Runtime metrics endpoint
manifest.description: The bearer-gated /metrics endpoint. Production refuses to expose it without a token, because Go runtime stats must not be public by default.

environment.description: Bearer token gating /metrics; required in production

manifest.name: modkit
manifest.title: Module registry engine
manifest.description: The registry engine and the ggg command line: catalog loading, dependency resolution, conflict-aware sync, pristine-only removal, transactional apply, and deterministic generation.

manifest.name: notifications
manifest.title: In-app notifications
manifest.description: Fire-and-forget in-app notifications and per-user delivery preferences, including the email digest cadence.

manifest.name: observability
manifest.title: Error reporting
manifest.description: Reporter port with a Sentry adapter and a no-op default so call sites never nil-check.

environment.description: Sentry DSN; unset uses the no-op reporter

manifest.name: organizations
manifest.title: Users, organizations, and membership
manifest.description: Core tenancy: the users, organizations, and memberships tables, their queries, and the initial schema every other module builds on.

manifest.name: rate-limit
manifest.title: Request rate limiting
manifest.description: Per-key token-bucket limiter with a bursting budget, used to shield the application from a single abusive client.

environment.description: Per-IP request budget per minute; bursts to twice this

manifest.name: schedules
manifest.title: Recurring work
manifest.description: The builder-facing helper for recurring jobs: a schedule row names a job kind and a cadence, and the scheduler pass enqueues it.

manifest.name: security
manifest.title: Middleware and request security
manifest.description: The load-bearing middleware chain — recover, request id, access log, locale, maintenance mode, rate limit, secure headers, session load, CSRF — and the route-group guards.

environment.description: Shed all traffic except probes and static with a 503

manifest.name: seed
manifest.title: Fixture loader
manifest.description: Loads a SQL fixture into the database, with an optional reset that drops and recreates the schema first.

manifest.name: seo
manifest.title: Discovery surfaces
manifest.description: robots.txt, the sitemap, and the canonical and alternate link metadata search engines read.

manifest.name: server
manifest.title: HTTP server core
manifest.description: The HTTP surface: the server struct and dependency seam, the route table, the HTMX fragment rules, and shared request parameter helpers.

manifest.name: static
manifest.title: Static asset serving
manifest.description: The embedded static file set — built CSS, client JavaScript, fonts, icons, and the vendored browser assets — served with content-addressed caching.

manifest.name: storage
manifest.title: Object storage
manifest.description: Store port with an R2/S3-compatible adapter and a development store rooted in tmp/uploads.

manifest.name: testdb
manifest.title: Per-package test databases
manifest.description: Gives every integration-test package its own database so parallel packages cannot nuke each other's fixtures. Skips when no server is reachable.

manifest.name: usage
manifest.title: Usage metering
manifest.description: Fire-and-forget usage records, flushed to the billing provider by a job.

manifest.name: webhooks
manifest.title: Outbound webhooks
manifest.description: Customer-facing webhook endpoints, signed emission, and secret rotation. Delivery attempts run as jobs.
